title: docs(devx): re-anchor the dead tracker citation in check-test-typecheck and regenerate the 19 test-typecheck ledgers
body:
Fixes #20715
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The shared test-typecheck gate wrote a tracker number that answers 404 (`#13470`) into the generated `_comment` of every package's `test-typecheck-debt.json`. This PR re-anchors it at the producer, `scripts/check-test-typecheck.mts`, and regenerates every copy with its own package's `gen:test-typecheck-debt`.

- **The `_comment` literal (`LEDGER_COMMENT`)** now says the lesson in words (ruling C+D's form D, no number): entries are per-signature "never to a bare total, because a total can hold while the errors underneath it are replaced wholesale". The fragment the gate pins by arrival, `never to a bare total`, is unchanged.
- **The other 23 lines of the producer that cite the same number** are re-anchored too, because the card's re-check names the whole file and answers 0 only when they are gone. Comment prose (6 sites) now cites commit `57827b617` (form C). Strings the author sees or the self-test prints (17 sites: 6 battery names and `battery()` calls, 10 assertion labels, the success line) say the lesson without a number (form D). Nothing else on those lines moved.
- **19 ledgers regenerated**, one `gen:test-typecheck-debt` per package, never by hand. In each, one line moved: `_comment`.
- **`packages/rest/test-typecheck-debt.json` also has its authored `_note` re-anchored by hand** (`#13470` became `commit 57827b617`). The generator never writes `_note` and preserves it verbatim, so no regeneration could reach it, and the card's re-check covers it.

20 files, 45 insertions and 44 deletions against base `05be35259`: the producer, plus one line in each of 19 ledgers (two in rest).

## Measured before building

- **The premise holds, and the card's count was short.** `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/13470` answers 404 (2026-10-01); #5286, #12624 and the other numbers in the same `_comment` answer 200. At base `05be35259` the card's re-check answers **44 lines**: 20 in the 19 ledgers (rest carries one in `_comment` and one in `_note`) and **24 in the producer**, not one.
- **H1, what regeneration costs and moves.** Regeneration re-measures each package's test errors, so it needed the dependency closure built: 59 turbo build tasks, 6m46s under the shared lock. After it, `--update` rewrote **only `_comment`** in all 19, and **no debt moved**: `entries`, key order and `_note` are byte-equal to base in every ledger (165 files, 1233 errors, 362 distinct signatures across the 19; every package's own count unchanged). No ledger was left unregenerated.
- **H2, whether the gate reads `_comment`.** It does not. `check:test-typecheck` judges `loadLedger().entries` alone, and nothing else reads a ledger's `_comment`. Mutation proof on `packages/rest`: with `_comment` set to a marker string, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest check:test-typecheck` still exits 0 (OK line printed); restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. So a producer edit without regeneration would not red anything; the regeneration is what makes the 19 copies true.
- **H3, the anchor.** `57827b617` ("pin test-typecheck debt by error IDENTITY, not per-file count") is the commit that decided per-signature entries; its message records the packages/rest ablation the number stood for. The repository history is deep enough: the commit is present, and `git log` on the producer lists it among 7 commits.

## Proof

- **Each regenerated copy changes only its `_comment` line.** A script compared every ledger at `HEAD~1` with the working copy: same keys and key order, `entries` byte-equal, `_note` equal, exactly one changed line, and the new `_comment` is the old one with exactly one clause replaced. Result: `ALL 19 carriers: only the _comment line moved`. Against base `05be35259` the same script reports one difference, rest, which changes two lines (`_comment` and the authored `_note`), as stated above.
- **Re-check.** `git grep -n "#13470" -- '*/test-typecheck-debt.json' scripts/check-test-typecheck.mts` answers 0 (exit 1). Positive control, same pathspec at the base commit: `git grep -c "#13470" 05be35259 -- ...` lists 20 files (19 ledgers plus the producer).
- **Self-test.** `tsx scripts/check-test-typecheck.mts --self-test` exits 0 at the final head; the renamed batteries still register against the roster floor, so no battery went unattributed.
- **Spot checks of the check mode** against the regenerated ledgers at the final head: rest, spec (52 files, 248 errors, 136 signatures) and runtime (27 files, 190 errors, 68 signatures) each print `check:test-typecheck: OK`.

## Gates (head `f9b496b88`)

`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` over the actual diff derives 74 commands. All 74 ran, each exit recorded before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciles: `74 derived, 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. All 74 exited 0, including `pnpm check:type-check-coverage`, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (re-measure: 4 ledger entries, 53 raw errors, none above its recorded number, surplus none), `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, `pnpm check:issue-citations`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:published-files`. Two gates first answered exit 3 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`: prerequisite not met, workspace not fully built, nothing measured); they were re-run after the build and exit 0. The first `check:type-check-debt` run was cut by my own 300s timeout (124); it re-ran under the lock after building `@objectstack/driver-mongodb`'s closure and exits 0. The whole lint workflow farm is CI's.

## Changeset

None, and `skip-changeset` applies: the producer is a root `scripts/` file and the ledgers ship in no tarball. Measured: the 19 packages' `files[]` list `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` (and spec's schema and docs paths), and a grep of those shipped paths for the ledger text and for `13470` finds 0 files, while the control `check-test-typecheck` finds 3 (cli, lint, runtime CHANGELOGs).

## Acceptance notes

Not changed here, because they sit outside this card's `#13470` scope. Each is the same family (a tracker number answering 404), found in the files this PR touches:

- `scripts/check-test-typecheck.mts`: `#13466` (lines 289, 625), `#8538` (939), `#6083` (1134).
- Authored `_note` fields: `packages/rest` `#13377`, `#13378`, `#13454`; `packages/core` `#14613`; `packages/client` `#6083`.
- `packages/client/test-typecheck-debt.json` was not one of the 19 and was not regenerated: its `_comment` predates the per-signature mechanism and is stale against the producer. A regeneration would move that line for a different reason than this card.

## Deviations from the dispatch order

1. The producer had 24 lines to re-anchor, not one (the card's own re-check requires all 24 to go).
2. `packages/rest` changes two lines, not one: its authored `_note` carried the same dead number.

Landing site is as expected (`scripts/check-test-typecheck.mts` and the generated ledgers). Clause-② stays `no`: nothing here widens an accept set or a public surface.
